newsitem.title: USA: Armey sees U.S. House passing air ticket tax.
newsitem.headline: Armey sees U.S. House passing air ticket tax.

text.p: House Majority Leader Dick Armey said Tuesday he expected the House to approve renewal of an airline ticket tax.
"I expect that to pass... on the basis of a strong bipartisan vote," the Texas Republican told reporters.

Armey said President Clinton and Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin had a responsibility to lobby for votes for the tax. He called the levy, which has been criticized by some conservatives, "a maintenance of effort" to pay for needed air safety.
The tax expired last year. The House is to vote Wednesday on restoring it under rules requiring approval by a two-thirds majority.
